blocks.text: The Philippines’ Miss Universe bet Bea Millan-Windorski may be thousands of miles away from home, but there is no stopping her from using her platform to help push back against Pax Silica and US “imperialism.” Pax Silica is a United States-led international economic and security initiative launched in December 2025 that aimed to ensure a steady supply chains of semiconductors and other critical minerals to reduce the world’s reliance on China. The Philippines has joined the initiative and is currently negotiating the terms, including putting up a 1,620-hectare facility in Central Luzon as a secmiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) hub.
